def make_key(text, profile, criteria):
    return (text, profile, criteria)

from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_key_includes_all_inputs():
    assert make_key("a", 2, 1) == ("a", 2, 1)

def test_recompute_on_any_change():
    results = []
    def compute():
        return ("v" + str(len(results)))
        results.append(1)
    store = {}
    assert score(store, "job", 1, 1, compute) == "v0"
    assert store[("job", 1, 1)] == "v0"
    assert score(store, "job", 1, 1, compute) == "v0"
    assert score(store, "job", 2, 1, compute) == "v1"
    assert score(store, "job", 1, 2, compute) == "v2"
    assert score(store, "job2", 1, 1, compute) == "v3"

def test_none_values_cached_and_distinguished():
    store = {}
    r1 = score(store, None, None, None, lambda: "none-key")
    assert store[(None, None, None)] == "none-key"
    assert score(store, None, None, None, lambda: "x") == "none-key"
    r2 = score(store, None, 1, None, lambda: "mixed")
    assert r1 != r2
    assert store[(None, None, None)] == "none-key"
    assert store[(None, 1, None)] == "mixed"

def test_no_ambiguous_concatenation():
    assert make_key("ab", 1, 2) != make_key("a", "b1", 2)
    assert make_key("ab", 1, 2) != make_key("a", "1b", 2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_key_includes_all_inputs()
    test_recompute_on_any_change()
    test_none_values_cached_and_distinguished()
    test_no_ambiguous_concatenation()
    print("all candidate tests passed")
